subject: Panel: Lina Gomez — post-interview notes & score consolidation
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Panel: Lina Gomez — post-interview notes & score consolidation

Hi all,

Thanks again for taking time to interview Lina this morning for the Staff ML Engineer role on Platform — Inference Runtime. Quick ask to keep us moving: please submit your numeric score (1-5) and a 1-2 sentence rationale in the attached score template by 1:00pm PT today.

Notes to include in the template: system design (scale & KV cache strategy), latency vs. quality tradeoffs, and cultural fit with infra SRE partnering. I attached a simple sheet for easy tallying (lina_gomez_score_template.xlsx).

If you have strong disagreement with the panel majority, add a 2-3 bullet note under the Qual section so we can surface in the sync. I expect a short convergence call only if scores are split 2/2/1.

We also need a short highlight doc for recruiting if we move to offer — one-paragraph summary + two risks. I started a Drive doc (link below) if you want to drop notes inline.

Timebox: scores in by 13:00 PT; I'll synthesize and DM a proposed recommendation.

Thanks,
Olga
Director, Talent Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: lina_gomez_score_template.xlsx
Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-lina-gomez-notes

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Panel: Lina Gomez — post-interview notes & score consolidation

Olga / team,

Submitted my scores in the sheet (overall 4). Quick rationale: strong on latency-oriented model routing and practical caching approaches; struggled a bit on the distributed KV consistency question — proposed eventual consistency plus sequence numbers, but I wanted more concrete read/write lease discussion.

Qual note: concerned about long-tail perf regression under multimodal batching — flagged as moderate risk.

No need for a sync from my side unless others disagree.

—Ben
Senior SWE, Serving Runtime

Team — I put my score in (overall 4). The numeric breakdown ends up 4 / 3 / 4 which is effectively a split because of our weighting on system design. I wrote a short one-page summary (attached) with highlights and two candidate risks; TL;DR: hireable with a focused onboarding plan.

Given the split, I suggest we loop Rishi for a quick tiebreak. Rishi — tagging you for a quick read of the highlights PDF (lina_gomez_interview_highlights.pdf) and a yes/no judgment (or a conditional yes). If you prefer, we can run a 10-min call at 4pm PT.

If Rishi is OOO for 4pm, let's default to holding until tomorrow morning.

Jonas
Lead, Platform Infra

Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Panel: Lina Gomez — post-interview notes & score consolidation

Thanks for the summary and the highlights doc — I reviewed. My read: Lina demonstrates the practical tradeoff judgement we need for inference-serving work and I value her experience shipping KV-aware caching logic. The system depth gaps are addressable through targeted onboarding and pairing with the runtime team for the first 6 weeks.

Decision: green-light to extend an offer. Please ask recruiting to prepare a leveling proposal at L5/L6 range (start at the hiring rubric midpoint) and include the two onboarding checks (pair-on design review, initial perf regression runbook). Marissa / Ben — can you each add one specific onboarding checkpoint to the Drive doc? Olga — if you can OK the recruiter outreach, we should aim to close by end of week.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
